summary_en: On 13 November 2026, Mitani Corporation executed an off-hours repurchase of 6.4 million shares at 2,664 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3, totaling 17.05 billion yen, representing 7.5% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On 13 November 2026, Mitani Corporation executed the acquisition of 6.4 million shares of its own stock through an off-hours trading transaction (ToSTNeT-3) at 2,664 yen per share, the closing price on 12 November 2026. The total acquisition cost was approximately 17.05 billion yen, representing 7.5% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The buy order was executed during the 8:45 a.m. trading session on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and results were published immediately after trading concluded.

The transaction results were based on sell orders from two related parties: Representative Director and President Satoshi Mitani and shareholder Shigeko Mitani, who expressed their intention to sell portions of their shareholdings. To avoid conflicts of interest, Representative Director Satoshi Mitani did not participate in the board deliberations and resolution authorizing this acquisition. Executive Officer Seiichiro Mitani, the son of Satoshi Mitani, also voluntarily abstained due to potential conflict of interest concerns.
